author: stahlleiton
body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds the hiRhoForEGReg collections used for the HIN egamma regression as estimators of underlying event estimator in the PbPb MiniAOD output. This allows to rerun or remake the egamma regression on top of MiniAOD using the same inputs as in reco. The increase in MiniAOD size per event is ~0.48% estimated with 10000 events from 2023 PbPb raw prime dataset.

@mandrenguyen

Tested locally
